アインアイク.role: Protagonist. Succubus general of the demon army, the "Purple-Flame General" (紫焔将), one of the 三鼎将 Three Generals; defeated, demoted, and confined in Cetus to be bred.
アインアイク.register: Formal, dutiful, self-serious. First person 私. Heavy use of obligation enders 〜ねば／〜しないと, trailing ……; proud military diction. In H-scenes breaks down into raw screams and pleading (おゆるしください, いやなのに…).
アインアイク.note: Female CONFIRMED: others call her サキュバス/淫魔将/牝, female pronouns. Romanization Einaike retained (no in-text reading contradicts it). Also addressed as 紫焔将/淫魔将(after demotion)/将軍/閣下.

モレク.role: "Thunder-Calm General" (雷穏将), one of the 三鼎将 Three Generals; commands the 雷穏軍 (magic research). Formal strategist/aide who briefs the Demon Lord and analyzes the 英雄/Heroes.
モレク.register: Formal military aide. はッ／左様／〜ております／〜ですな／〜模様です. Clipped reports, deferential 陛下. Dry sigh やれやれ. Refers to Furfur dismissively as フォルファクスめ.
モレク.note: Male confirmed. Same character under fuller box 雷穏将モレク (separate entry).

ヴィネ.role: "Ice-Blast General" (氷爆将), one of the 三鼎将 Three Generals; commands the 氷爆軍 (beast-demon handling, sabotage). Later pleads with the Demon Lord for Einaike's release.
ヴィネ.register: Crude, rough soldier; Kansai-tinged. First person オレ/自分. Rough enders 〜だぜ／〜ねぇ／〜じゃねぇか and ッカァー interjections; but speaks politely-rough to the Demon Lord (陛下, 〜でしょうや, 違いますかね). Cynical, blunt.
ヴィネ.note: Male confirmed (オレ, soldierly register). Same character appears under the fuller name-box 氷爆将ヴィネ (see separate entry).

フォルファクス.role: Great-demon antagonist, "Vicious-Horn Lord" (凶角卿), founder/commander of the 凶角団 (Vicious-Horn Corps); a former superior of Einaike's. Sadistic researcher of native biology; later herself sent to Cetus.
フォルファクス.register: Theatrical sadist. First person アタシ. Signature cackle キッヒ／キヒヒ／キィーッヒッヒッヒ. Long elongated vowels サァ／じゃぁないか, mocking honorifics (優等生ドノ, 貴公). Archly polite-cruel.
フォルファクス.note: GENDER CORRECTION: the brief says MALE — WRONG. Hydra calls her 彼女 ("she", her line at 153) and a Bigfoot/Hydra-type calls her あのクソ生意気な牛娘 ("that cheeky cow-girl", line 1130), i.e. a Minotaur-type female. 卿/Lord here is a gender-neutral rank title. Treat as FEMALE. Ars Goetia Furfur/Forfax (often depicted with bull/stag form, consistent with 牛娘).

副官.note: Gender unknown (no decisive gendered marker; could be male officer). Likely the same role as 紫焔軍・副官 but separate box; flag whether to merge.

教官トロール.role: Base demon-race (基底魔族); Troll drill instructor of the Purple-Flame Army barracks (named NPC role, not a battle variant).
教官トロール.note: Story NPC (trainer), not a bred battle unit per se, but a Troll-race demon.

教官ミノタウロス.role: Base demon-race (基底魔族); Minotaur drill instructor of the Purple-Flame Army (named NPC role, not a battle variant).
教官ミノタウロス.note: Story NPC (trainer), not a bred battle unit, but a Minotaur-race demon.

侍従長.role: The Demon Lord's chief chamberlain; gatekeeps audiences and dismissively appraises the returned Einaike as a mere lowly-species specimen.
侍従長.register: Haughty court servant. 〜ております／〜ですな／はぁ; condescending toward 弱小種族の一匹. Officious, snobbish.
侍従長.note: Gender male (court-official register). Named court-role character.

英雄・\"勇者\".role: Elite 英雄 (Hero) born among the natives; noble commander of the Hero party who rallies them against the demon-kin to protect Vendia's world.
英雄・\"勇者\".register: Noble, commanding, formal. First person 我ら/我々/この私; archaic 〜がいい／〜なかれ／討ち滅ぼさせてもらおう. Named attacks 寂光…一閃 / 寂光. Resolute, idealistic.
英雄・\"勇者\".note: Male confirmed (noble masculine register). Romanization "the Valiant" for 勇者 per brief. NOTE: file also has bare-quote 英雄・勇者 and 英雄・賢者 etc. as separate boxes — see consolidation note below.

英雄・\"戦士\".role: Elite 英雄 (Hero); the party's hot-blooded frontline bruiser. Believes in answering violence with violence.
英雄・\"戦士\".register: Crude, aggressive. オレ/オレら; rough 〜やがれ／〜じゃねぇか／スカタン／クソッ. Mocks teammates (スカシ野郎, 模範生クン). Belligerent.
英雄・\"戦士\".note: Male confirmed. Romanization "the Warrior" for 戦士. Same character as bare-quote box 英雄・戦士.

英雄・\"武人\".role: Elite 英雄 (Hero); the party's disciplined veteran/martial-artist. Steady, observant, watches over the others.
英雄・\"武人\".register: Composed warrior. 〜ぞ／〜ゆえ／むぅ; terse, measured, faintly wry (フッ). Mature, level-headed.
英雄・\"武人\".note: Male confirmed. Romanization "the Champion" for 武人. Same character as bare-quote box 英雄・武人.

英雄・\"魔女\".role: Elite 英雄 (Hero); the party's strategist/analyst. Assesses the threat of the breeding succubus (Einaike) and her ever-strengthening offspring.
英雄・\"魔女\".register: Cool, analytical, polite-feminine. 〜ですね／〜でしょう／〜ますよ; measured threat-assessment, occasional dry warnings. Calm tactician.
英雄・\"魔女\".note: Female confirmed (feminine polite enders; role = 魔女/Witch strategist per brief). Also appears as bare-quote box 英雄・魔女.

英雄・\"賢者\".role: Elite 英雄 (Hero); elder advisor of the party who counsels caution and reads the enemy's growth rate.
英雄・\"賢者\".register: Calm elder-scholar. 〜かね／〜ぞ／〜と思うが…; reflective, restrained, advisory. Uses そなた. Weary wisdom.
英雄・\"賢者\".note: Gender male (elder-scholar register, no contradicting line). Romanization "the Sage" for 賢者. Also bare-quote box 英雄・賢者 (which additionally contains a ヒヒッ-cackling line — possibly mislabeled/shared; flag).

カロン.role: Administrator and lore-guide of the Cetus (ケートゥス) breeding facility; explains its origin, timeless nature, and rules.
カロン.register: Archaic-courteous elder. Sentence-enders ですな／ます／おりませぬ／やもしれません; chuckle ほほ. Measured, expository, deferential (貴女, 閣下).
カロン.note: Gender male/neutral elder, consistent with brief. No line contradicts. Self-describes as 管理者側たる私.

ミノタウロス（牝）.role: Base demon-race (基底魔族); a female Minotaur being violated/bred (H-scene victim).
ミノタウロス（牝）.note: Rare female of an otherwise male unit race; appears as a bred victim, parallel to the heroine's fate.

原住民・神言騎士.role: Native (human) elite holy knight (神言騎士) who fights the demon-kin and buys time for the 英雄/Hero to be born; mentioned as the benchmark the offspring surpass.
原住民・神言騎士.register: Valiant, archaic-martial. おのれ魔族め／来るがいい／〜してくれよう; defiant, self-sacrificing 死地と心得た身. Heroic resignation.
原住民・神言騎士.note: Gender male (martial knight register). A named native unit-type (not a demon monster species); included as it is a recurring story faction role. Several lettered variants exist (神言騎士A etc.).

原住民・神言騎士A・B.role: native soldier (enemy/human); battlefield unit; two knights speaking

英雄・侍.role: An additional named 英雄 (Hero) of the native party ("the Samurai"); reacts with alarm to how monstrously the demon has grown since the last repulse.
英雄・侍.register: Single sample only: shocked exclamation これが…魔族だというのか…！？. Insufficient for tics; martial/serious tone implied.
英雄・侍.note: Gender male assumed (侍/samurai, martial). A 5th+ named Hero beyond the brief's listed five — included as a clearly-named story character. Romanization "the Samurai" for 侍. Flag: minimal data.

最終兵器ガルデン・ヴェンド.role: "Ultimate Weapon" named entity — a story-significant boss/weapon (likely the natives' last-resort creation tied to 創世神ヴェンディア/Vendia, given the name). Only an inarticulate line (………………！) in the sample.
最終兵器ガルデン・ヴェンド.register: Silent in sample (only ………………！). No speech tics to characterize.
最終兵器ガルデン・ヴェンド.note: Gender unknown (no dialogue/markers). Named story entity, not a monster species — included per task. Romanization ガルデン=Garden, ヴェンド=Vend; name echoes ヴェンディア/Vendia (creator goddess) — possibly "Garden of Vendia"/Vend. Flag for human review of intended romanization.

紫焔将マルコシアス.role: Field commander (titled Purple-Flame General here) reporting native-suppression results and pleading with the king for Einaike's amnesty (恩赦). See gender/identity note under マルコシアス.
紫焔将マルコシアス.register: Formal field report. 〜ております／〜ませぬ; clipped suppression reports; earnest plea どうか…恩赦を. Loyal, composed.
紫焔将マルコシアス.note: Male confirmed. Likely the same Marchosias as the king's retainer, here given the 紫焔将 rank-title box (possible dev reuse of the title after Einaike's fall, or a separate officer). Flag for human review against story context.

赤冠王マクドネル.role: The reigning Demon Lord, holder of the secret art "Red Cap" (レッドキャップ); regal and terse. Rebukes his retainers; bound by the Dark God's decree.
赤冠王マクドネル.register: Terse, commanding. Curt うむ／〜であろう／〜だぞ; orders 口を閉じろ／口が過ぎるぞ. Long silences (………………). Reluctant authority.
赤冠王マクドネル.note: Male confirmed. Same individual as the 魔王 box; this box used for throne-room command scenes. Addresses subordinates by rank (雷穏将) or name (マルコシアス, ヴィネ).

氷爆将ヴィネ.role: Fuller name-box for Vine in the climactic throne-room scene where he argues that Einaike has served her purpose and begs the king to free her from Cetus; later senses the world collapsing.
氷爆将ヴィネ.register: Rough but earnest. オレ/自分; Kansai-rough 〜でしょうや／〜違いますかね／〜ねぇ; emotional plea あまりにも酷でしょうや. Gruff compassion.
氷爆将ヴィネ.note: Male confirmed. Same character as ヴィネ; merge in glossary, distinct box used for plot-critical scene.

雷穏将モレク.role: Fuller name-box for Moloch in the throne-room scene; raises concerns about the offspring's runaway strength and joins the plea to release Einaike; senses the cataclysm.
雷穏将モレク.register: Formal aide. 左様／〜ますぞ／はっ; deferential 陛下; measured strategic caution.
雷穏将モレク.note: Male confirmed. Same character as モレク; merge in glossary.

\"蒼\"の魔王、リバイアサン.role: Primordial eldritch origin of all demon-kin; "the one who set the table" (卓を整えし存在). Sent into the world by the Dark God "Human" (ニンゲン) to devour the creation of goddess Vendia. Source/true nature of the 魔族.
\"蒼\"の魔王、リバイアサン.register: Solemn, archaic, oracular. Plural/collective self 我／我ら／我らの本性. Cosmic-mythic narration, long ellipses, control codes (\!). Detached, ancient.
\"蒼\"の魔王、リバイアサン.note: Gender UNKNOWN/neutral confirmed (plural eldritch self, no gendered marker). "蒼"/Azure contrasts with Einaike as the "紫"/Purple Demon Lord (see 原住民・兵士 line referring to "紫"の魔王). Lore: world made by 創世神ヴェンディア/Vendia; Dark God = ニンゲン/Human.

サキュバスの子.role: A succubus child (Einaike's offspring/a young succubus) who laments being left alone by Einaike and is then attacked; childlike and innocent.
サキュバスの子.register: Childish, plaintive. Drawn-out ねぇーねぇー／はあぁーい; simple kana-heavy speech, frightened ひぃぃぃッ. Lonely, vulnerable.
サキュバスの子.note: Gender female (succubus = female species; childlike feminine speech). A named story character, not a monster species — included per task.

ケートゥ.role: A childlike, amnesiac voice — apparently the personified/embodied facility "ケートゥス"/Cetus (truncated label), dimly half-remembering being told it is the demons' only hope and wondering what 魔族 even are.
ケートゥ.register: Childlike, dreamy, forgetful. Kana-heavy, vague まぞくって、なんだろう…; lonely 誰か、いないかなぁ; trailing ellipses. Innocent, untethered.
ケートゥ.note: Gender unknown (no gendered markers; childlike). Label appears truncated from ケートゥス. A named story entity, not a monster species — included. Flag: confirm whether this is the facility's avatar or a specific child character.

マルコシアス.role: Retainer of King McDonnell. In throne scenes speaks bluntly enough to be rebuked. Note: a separate name-box 紫焔将マルコシアス also appears (see note).
マルコシアス.register: Direct retainer's speech; rebuked by the king for 口が過ぎる (speaking out of turn).
マルコシアス.note: Male confirmed. CAUTION/likely data inconsistency: the brief lists マルコシアス as McDonnell's retainer, but the file's 25-line speaker is labeled 紫焔将マルコシアス ("Purple-Flame General Marchosias") — a battlefield field-commander reporting native suppression and begging the king for Einaike's amnesty (恩赦). Either the dev reused the Marchosias name for Einaike's subordinate field officer, or these are two boxes for one person. The bare マルコシアス key here has only the in-throne mention; treat 紫焔将マルコシアス as the speaking variant. Flag for human review.
